summary: Crash when setting LodestonePos of compass to something other than NBT compound
description: The bug The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos having a value other than an NBT compound tag. [^(20w17a) crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la at bhr.a(SourceFile:144) at bje.a(SourceFile:454) at bcw.j(SourceFile:290) at bcx.l(SourceFile:575) at anz.h(SourceFile:2217) at bcx.h(SourceFile:274) at ys.i(SourceFile:411) at zj.b(SourceFile:199) at ma.a(SourceFile:234) at zi.c(SourceFile:171) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:839) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:766) at enn.a(SourceFile:89) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.run(SourceFile:625) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) How to reproduce Do this in a test world /give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"} The game freezes and you will see in the log file that it has crashed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new test world.
3. Open the chat and enter the command: `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`.
4. Press Enter to execute the command.
5. Wait a moment to observe the game behavior.
6. Observe that the game crashes and check the log file for the crash report.
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to create or modify a compass item in Minecraft with an invalid LodestonePos value, specifically one that is not formatted as an NBT compound tag, the game experiences a crash. This occurs when the LodestonePos is assigned a string value, such as "This is not an NBT compound", instead of a valid NBT structure. The error is triggered during the player-ticking process, resulting in a `java.lang.ClassCastException`. The stack trace indicates that the game is trying to cast an invalid object type, leading to a failure in processing the compass item.

The crash log generated contains the following key details:

```

java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la

```

To reproduce this bug, the following command can be executed in a test world:

```
/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}
```

Upon executing this command, the game will freeze and subsequently crash, with the error being logged as described above. This behavior indicates that the game does not handle invalid LodestonePos values gracefully, resulting in a critical failure that disrupts gameplay.
Expected Behavior: When setting the LodestonePos of a compass to a valid NBT compound tag, the game should successfully create or modify the compass item without any crashes or errors. The compass should properly reference the specified lodestone position, allowing players to use it for navigation without encountering any issues. This expected behavior should be consistent across all relevant game versions.
